# Package org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode

This package provides classes to solve Ordinary Differential Equations problems.

This package solves Initial Value Problems of the form
`y'=f(t,y)` with `t0` and
`y(t0)=y0` known. The provided
integrators compute an estimate of `y(t)` from
`t=t0` to `t=t1`.
It is also possible to get the derivatives with respect to the initial state
`dy(t)/dy(t0)` or the derivatives with
respect to some ODE parameters `dy(t)/dp`.

All integrators provide dense output. This means that besides
computing the state vector at discrete times, they also provide a
cheap mean to get the state between the time steps. They do so through
classes extending the [`StepInterpolator`](sampling/StepInterpolator.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.sampling")
abstract class, which are made available to the user at the end of
each step.

All integrators handle multiple discrete events detection based on switching
functions. This means that the integrator can be driven by user specified
discrete events. The steps are shortened as needed to ensure the events occur
at step boundaries (even if the integrator is a fixed-step
integrator). When the events are triggered, integration can be stopped
(this is called a G-stop facility), the state vector can be changed,
or integration can simply go on. The latter case is useful to handle
discontinuities in the differential equations gracefully and get
accurate dense output even close to the discontinuity.

The user should describe his problem in his own classes
(`UserProblem` in the diagram below) which should implement
the [`FirstOrderDifferentialEquations`](FirstOrderDifferentialEquations.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode") interface. Then he should pass it to
the integrator he prefers among all the classes that implement the
[`FirstOrderIntegrator`](FirstOrderIntegrator.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode") interface.

The solution of the integration problem is provided by two means. The
first one is aimed towards simple use: the state vector at the end of
the integration process is copied in the `y` array of the
[`FirstOrderIntegrator.integrate`](FirstOrderIntegrator.html#integrate(org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.FirstOrderDifferentialEquations,double,double%5B%5D,double,double%5B%5D)) method. The second one should be used
when more in-depth information is needed throughout the integration
process. The user can register an object implementing the [`StepHandler`](sampling/StepHandler.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.sampling") interface or a
[`StepNormalizer`](sampling/StepNormalizer.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.sampling")
object wrapping a user-specified object implementing the [`FixedStepHandler`](sampling/FixedStepHandler.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.sampling")
interface into the integrator before calling the [`FirstOrderIntegrator.integrate`](FirstOrderIntegrator.html#integrate(org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.FirstOrderDifferentialEquations,double,double%5B%5D,double,double%5B%5D)) method. The user object will be called
appropriately during the integration process, allowing the user to
process intermediate results. The default step handler does nothing.

[`ContinuousOutputModel`](ContinuousOutputModel.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode") is a special-purpose step handler that is able
to store all steps and to provide transparent access to any
intermediate result once the integration is over. An important feature
of this class is that it implements the `Serializable`
interface. This means that a complete continuous model of the
integrated function throughout the integration range can be serialized
and reused later (if stored into a persistent medium like a file system
or a database) or elsewhere (if sent to another application). Only the
result of the integration is stored, there is no reference to the
integrated problem by itself.

Other default implementations of the [`StepHandler`](sampling/StepHandler.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.sampling") interface are
available for general needs ([`DummyStepHandler`](sampling/DummyStepHandler.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.sampling"), [`StepNormalizer`](sampling/StepNormalizer.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.sampling")) and custom
implementations can be developed for specific needs. As an example,
if an application is to be completely driven by the integration
process, then most of the application code will be run inside a step
handler specific to this application.

Some integrators (the simple ones) use fixed steps that are set at
creation time. The more efficient integrators use variable steps that
are handled internally in order to control the integration error with
respect to a specified accuracy (these integrators extend the [`AdaptiveStepsizeIntegrator`](nonstiff/AdaptiveStepsizeIntegrator.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.nonstiff") abstract class). In this case, the step
handler which is called after each successful step shows up the
variable stepsize. The [`StepNormalizer`](sampling/StepNormalizer.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.sampling") class can
be used to convert the variable stepsize into a fixed stepsize that
can be handled by classes implementing the [`FixedStepHandler`](sampling/FixedStepHandler.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.sampling")
interface. Adaptive stepsize integrators can automatically compute the
initial stepsize by themselves, however the user can specify it if he
prefers to retain full control over the integration or if the
automatic guess is wrong.

Fixed Step Integrators

| Fixed Step Integrators | |
| Name | Order |
| [`Euler`](nonstiff/EulerIntegrator.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.nonstiff") | 1 |
| [`Midpoint`](nonstiff/MidpointIntegrator.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.nonstiff") | 2 |
| [`Classical Runge-Kutta`](nonstiff/ClassicalRungeKuttaIntegrator.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.nonstiff") | 4 |
| [`Gill`](nonstiff/GillIntegrator.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.nonstiff") | 4 |
| [`3/8`](nonstiff/ThreeEighthesIntegrator.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.nonstiff") | 4 |
| [`Luther`](nonstiff/LutherIntegrator.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.nonstiff") | 6 |

Adaptive Stepsize Integrators

| Adaptive Stepsize Integrators | | |
| Name | Integration Order | Error Estimation Order |
| [`Higham and Hall`](nonstiff/HighamHall54Integrator.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.nonstiff") | 5 | 4 |
| [`Dormand-Prince 5(4)`](nonstiff/DormandPrince54Integrator.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.nonstiff") | 5 | 4 |
| [`Dormand-Prince 8(5,3)`](nonstiff/DormandPrince853Integrator.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.nonstiff") | 8 | 5 and 3 |
| [`Gragg-Bulirsch-Stoer`](nonstiff/GraggBulirschStoerIntegrator.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.nonstiff") | variable (up to 18 by default) | variable |
| [`Adams-Bashforth`](nonstiff/AdamsBashforthIntegrator.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.nonstiff") | variable | variable |
| [`Adams-Moulton`](nonstiff/AdamsMoultonIntegrator.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.nonstiff") | variable | variable |

In the table above, the [`Adams-Bashforth`](nonstiff/AdamsBashforthIntegrator.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.nonstiff") and [`Adams-Moulton`](nonstiff/AdamsMoultonIntegrator.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.ode.nonstiff") integrators appear as variable-step ones. This is an experimental extension
to the classical algorithms using the Nordsieck vector representation.

# Package org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.stat.descriptive

Generic univariate summary statistic objects.

**UnivariateStatistic API Usage Examples:**

***UnivariateStatistic:***

`/∗ evaluation approach ∗/  
double[] values = new double[] { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 };  
UnivariateStatistic stat = new Mean();  
out.println("mean = " + stat.evaluate(values));`

***StorelessUnivariateStatistic:***

`/∗ incremental approach ∗/  
double[] values = new double[] { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 };  
StorelessUnivariateStatistic stat = new Mean();  
out.println("mean before adding a value is NaN = " + stat.getResult());  
for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {  
    stat.increment(values[i]);  
    out.println("current mean = " + stat2.getResult());  
}  
 stat.clear();  
out.println("mean after clear is NaN = " + stat.getResult());`

# Package org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.analysis

Parent package for common numerical analysis procedures, including root finding,
function interpolation and integration. Note that optimization (i.e. minimization
and maximization) is a separate top-level package.

Function interfaces are intended to be implemented by user code to represent
domain problems. The algorithms provided by the library operate on these
functions to find their roots, or integrate them, or ... Functions can be multivariate
or univariate, real vectorial or matrix-valued, and they can be differentiable or not.

* Interface Summary

  | Interface | Description |
  |  |  |
  | --- | --- |
  | [BivariateFunction](BivariateFunction.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.analysis") | An interface representing a bivariate real function. |
  | [MultivariateFunction](MultivariateFunction.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.analysis") | An interface representing a multivariate real function. |
  | [MultivariateMatrixFunction](MultivariateMatrixFunction.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.analysis") | An interface representing a multivariate matrix function. |
  | [MultivariateVectorFunction](MultivariateVectorFunction.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.analysis") | An interface representing a multivariate vectorial function. |
  | [ParametricUnivariateFunction](ParametricUnivariateFunction.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.analysis") | An interface representing a real function that depends on one independent variable plus some extra parameters. |
  | [RealFieldUnivariateFunction](RealFieldUnivariateFunction.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.analysis")<T extends [RealFieldElement](../core/RealFieldElement.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.core")<T>> | An interface representing a univariate real function. |
  | [TrivariateFunction](TrivariateFunction.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.analysis") | An interface representing a trivariate real function. |
  | [UnivariateFunction](UnivariateFunction.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.analysis") | An interface representing a univariate real function. |
  | [UnivariateMatrixFunction](UnivariateMatrixFunction.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.analysis") | An interface representing a univariate matrix function. |

# How This API Document Is Organized

This API (Application Programming Interface) document has pages corresponding to the items in the navigation bar, described as follows.

* ## Overview

  The [Overview](index.html) page is the front page of this API document and provides a list of all packages with a summary for each. This page can also contain an overall description of the set of packages.
* ## Package

  Each package has a page that contains a list of its classes and interfaces, with a summary for each. These pages may contain six categories:

  * Interfaces
  * Classes
  * Enums
  * Exceptions
  * Errors
  * Annotation Types
* ## Class or Interface

  Each class, interface, nested class and nested interface has its own separate page. Each of these pages has three sections consisting of a class/interface description, summary tables, and detailed member descriptions:

  * Class Inheritance Diagram
  * Direct Subclasses
  * All Known Subinterfaces
  * All Known Implementing Classes
  * Class or Interface Declaration
  * Class or Interface Description  
  * Nested Class Summary
  * Field Summary
  * Property Summary
  * Constructor Summary
  * Method Summary  
  * Field Detail
  * Property Detail
  * Constructor Detail
  * Method Detail

  Each summary entry contains the first sentence from the detailed description for that item. The summary entries are alphabetical, while the detailed descriptions are in the order they appear in the source code. This preserves the logical groupings established by the programmer.
* ## Annotation Type

  Each annotation type has its own separate page with the following sections:

  * Annotation Type Declaration
  * Annotation Type Description
  * Required Element Summary
  * Optional Element Summary
  * Element Detail
* ## Enum

  Each enum has its own separate page with the following sections:

  * Enum Declaration
  * Enum Description
  * Enum Constant Summary
  * Enum Constant Detail
* ## Use

  Each documented package, class and interface has its own Use page. This page describes what packages, classes, methods, constructors and fields use any part of the given class or package. Given a class or interface A, its "Use" page includes subclasses of A, fields declared as A, methods that return A, and methods and constructors with parameters of type A. You can access this page by first going to the package, class or interface, then clicking on the "Use" link in the navigation bar.
* ## Tree (Class Hierarchy)

  There is a [Class Hierarchy](overview-tree.html) page for all packages, plus a hierarchy for each package. Each hierarchy page contains a list of classes and a list of interfaces. Classes are organized by inheritance structure starting with `java.lang.Object`. Interfaces do not inherit from `java.lang.Object`.

  * When viewing the Overview page, clicking on "Tree" displays the hierarchy for all packages.
  * When viewing a particular package, class or interface page, clicking on "Tree" displays the hierarchy for only that package.
* ## Deprecated API

  The [Deprecated API](deprecated-list.html) page lists all of the API that have been deprecated. A deprecated API is not recommended for use, generally due to improvements, and a replacement API is usually given. Deprecated APIs may be removed in future implementations.
* ## Index

  The [Index](index-all.html) contains an alphabetic index of all classes, interfaces, constructors, methods, and fields, as well as lists of all packages and all classes.
* ## All Classes

  The [All Classes](allclasses.html) link shows all classes and interfaces except non-static nested types.
* ## Serialized Form

  Each serializable or externalizable class has a description of its serialization fields and methods. This information is of interest to re-implementors, not to developers using the API. While there is no link in the navigation bar, you can get to this information by going to any serialized class and clicking "Serialized Form" in the "See also" section of the class description.
* ## Constant Field Values

  The [Constant Field Values](constant-values.html) page lists the static final fields and their values.
* ## Search

  You can search for definitions of modules, packages, types, fields, methods and other terms defined in the API, using some or all of the name. "Camel-case" abbreviations are supported: for example, "InpStr" will find "InputStream" and "InputStreamReader".

# Package org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.fitting

Classes to perform curve fitting.
Curve fitting is a special case of a least-squares problem
where the parameters are the coefficients of a function \( f \)
whose graph \( y = f(x) \) should pass through sample points, and
were the objective function is the squared sum of the residuals
\( f(x\_i) - y\_i \) for observed points \( (x\_i, y\_i) \).

* Class Summary

  | Class | Description |
  |  |  |
  | --- | --- |
  | [AbstractCurveFitter](AbstractCurveFitter.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.fitting") | Base class that contains common code for fitting parametric univariate real functions `y = f(pi;x)`, where `x` is the independent variable and the `pi` are the *parameters*. |
  | [AbstractCurveFitter.TheoreticalValuesFunction](AbstractCurveFitter.TheoreticalValuesFunction.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.fitting") | Vector function for computing function theoretical values. |
  | [GaussianCurveFitter](GaussianCurveFitter.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.fitting") | Fits points to a [`Gaussian`](../analysis/function/Gaussian.Parametric.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.analysis.function") function. |
  | [GaussianCurveFitter.ParameterGuesser](GaussianCurveFitter.ParameterGuesser.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.fitting") | Guesses the parameters `norm`, `mean`, and `sigma` of a [`Gaussian.Parametric`](../analysis/function/Gaussian.Parametric.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.analysis.function") based on the specified observed points. |
  | [HarmonicCurveFitter](HarmonicCurveFitter.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.fitting") | Fits points to a [`harmonic oscillator`](../analysis/function/HarmonicOscillator.Parametric.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.analysis.function") function. |
  | [HarmonicCurveFitter.ParameterGuesser](HarmonicCurveFitter.ParameterGuesser.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.fitting") | This class guesses harmonic coefficients from a sample. |
  | [PolynomialCurveFitter](PolynomialCurveFitter.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.fitting") | Fits points to a [`polynomial`](../analysis/polynomials/PolynomialFunction.Parametric.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.analysis.polynomials") function. |
  | [SimpleCurveFitter](SimpleCurveFitter.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.fitting") | Fits points to a user-defined [`function`](../analysis/ParametricUnivariateFunction.html "interface in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.analysis"). |
  | [SimpleCurveFitter.ParameterGuesser](SimpleCurveFitter.ParameterGuesser.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.fitting") | Guesses the parameters. |
  | [WeightedObservedPoint](WeightedObservedPoint.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.fitting") | This class is a simple container for weighted observed point in [`curve fitting`](AbstractCurveFitter.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.fitting"). |
  | [WeightedObservedPoints](WeightedObservedPoints.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.fitting") | Simple container for weighted observed points used in [`curve fitting`](AbstractCurveFitter.html "class in org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.fitting") algorithms. |

      :   `MathIllegalArgumentException` - when the activated method itself can ascertain that preconditions,

          have been violated. In the vast majority of cases where Commons Math
          throws this exception, it is the result of argument checking of actual
          parameters immediately passed to a method.

## Apache Commons Math Release Notes

### Release History

| Version | Date | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [4.0-beta2](#a4.0-beta2) | TBD | This is a major release that requires source changes in applications. Lower-level functionality has been split off to new components, often with bug-fixes, performance enhancements and improved API: Commons RNG, Commons Numbers, Commons Geometry, Commons Statistics. Functionality still within Commons Math has been modularized and partly refactored. This is a work-in-progress (help welcome). Codes for which the refactoring has not been undertaken (or was deemed incomplete) have been moved to 'legacy' modules. The minimum version of the Java platform required to compile and use Commons Math is Java 8. Users are encouraged to upgrade to this version, and to the new components listed above (they are now Commons Math's dependencies). For code now located in the 'commons-math-legacy' module, upgrading will be a matter of changing the top-level package name: From 'org.apache.commons.math3' to 'org.apache.commons.math4.legacy'. Code in the 'commons-math-legacy-core' module comprise classes that moved from package 'org.apache.commons.math3' and package 'org.apache.commons.math3.util' (e.g. 'MathArrays') to package 'org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.core'. Notes: Class 'FastMath' was renamed 'AccurateMath' (now located in package 'org.apache.commons.math4.legacy.core.jdkmath'). Caveat: Although hundreds of issues have been fixed (see 'git log' and the reports in the bug-tracking system of all the listed components), many remain due to the lack of human resources necessary in order to support the whole codebase (it was one of the main reasons for creating more focused components). |
| [4.0-beta1](#a4.0-beta1) | 2022-12-20 | This is a major release that requires source changes in applications. This release contains some minor compatibility breaks with version 2.1 in some internal classes but none of them are in APIs likely to be accessed by user code: the MessagesResources\_fr class has been removed (replaced by a properties file); the arguments of the EventState.reinitializeBegin method have changed; some protected fields which already had public accessors in AbstractStepInterpolator have been replaced. There is a behavior change that users of the multiple regression classes should be aware of. In version 2.1, there was no way to estimate models without intercept terms, and, while this was not clear from the documentation, design (X) matrices needed to include initial unitary columns. In 2.2, initial unitary columns are not necessary and whether or not models include intercept terms is configurable. See the change log and javadoc for the classes in org.apache.commons.math3.stat.regression for details. The major new features are: a new FastMath class, both faster, more accurate and with a few additional functions than StrictMath and Math; a new package for floating point arbitrary precision computing, including high level functions like exponential, sine, square root ...; new linear and tricubic interpolators; a new Gaussian curve fitter; a new erfc function; characteristic support for distributions; a set of new Well Equidistributed Long-period Linear (WELL) random generators. |
| [2.1](#a2.1) | 2010-04-02 | This is primarily a maintenance release, but it also includes new features and enhancements. Users of version 2.0 are encouraged to upgrade to 2.1, as this release includes some important bug fixes. See the detailed list of changes below for full description of all bug fixes and enhancements. This release contains some minor API compatibility breaks with version 2.0: the return type of RealVector.copy() has been changed to AbstractRealVector; the no-argument constructor of MatrixUtils() has been made private; the mapXxxToSelf methods of OpenMapRealVector have been removed and some method return types have been changed in this class; new methods have been added to the RealVector interface; several fields in AdaptiveStepSizeIntegrator have been made final; DummyStepInterpolator requires an additional argument for one of its constructors; some protected fields have been removed from AbstractLeastSquaresOptimizer, AbstractScalarDifferentiableOptimizer and AbstractLinearOptimizer; and the isOptimal(SimplexTableau) method has been removed from SimplexSolver. |
| [2.0](#a2.0) | 2009-08-03 | This is a major release. It combines bug fixes, new features and changes to existing features. Most notable among the new features are: decomposition algorithms in the linear algebra package (LU, QR, Cholesky, SVD, eigen decomposition) which are based on the popular JAMA API (but much faster); support for sparse matrices and vectors; support for any field-based matrix (Complex, Fraction ...); support for genetic algorithms; several new optimization algorithms (Dantzig's simplex for linear constrained problems, conjugate gradient, Brent); support for curve fitting with special cases for harmonic and polynomial functions; support for state derivative in ODE step handlers; new multistep integrators (Adams-Bashforth and Adams-Moulton) with variable stepsize; regression algorithms; rank transformations; Mersenne twister pseudo random number generator. This release is NOT source and binary compatible with earlier versions of Commons Math. Starting with version 2.0 of the library, the minimal version of the Java platform required to compile and use Commons Math is Java 5. Users are encouraged to upgrade to this version, as in addition to new features, this release includes numerous bug fixes. Users of Commons Math 1.0-1.2 should recompile their code against the 2.0 jar. Most of the compilation errors users will encounter after the switch will be due to classes moved due to package reorganization. These errors are simply solved by adjusting the import statements in users code. |
| [1.2](#a1.2) | 2008-02-24 | This release combines bug fixes and new features. Most notable among the new features are the estimation, optimization, geometry and ode packages added from the Mantissa library. Implementations of fast Fourier transform, QR decomposition and several numerical integration algorithms have also been added, along with enhancements and extensions to packages included in Commons Math 1.1. This release is source and binary compatible with earlier versions of Commons Math. |
| [1.1](#a1.1) | 2005-12-17 | This is a maintenance release containing bug fixes and enhancements. All API changes are binary compatible with version 1.0. The enhancements include some new probability distributions, a Fraction class, new matrix and numerical utilities, and a PRNG pluggability framework making it possible to replace the JDK-supplied random number generator in Commons Math (and elsewhere) with alternative PRNG implementations. |
| [1.0](#a1.0) | 2004-12-06 | Apache Commons Math 1.0 - Initial Release |

| Remove | Removed methods "test(...)" from "AbstractUnivariateStatistic". The already existing methods "MathArrays#verifyValues(...)" shall be used instead. Fixes [MATH-1205](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1205). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Update | The abstract class "AbstractStorelessUnivariateStatistic" does not extend anymore from "AbstractUnivariateStatistic". Fixes [MATH-1205](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1205). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Update | Default implementation of "AbstractStorelessUnivariateStatistic#equals(Object)" will only return true if both instances have the same type. Fixes [MATH-1205](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1205). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Update | Default implementations of "AbstractStorelessUnivariateStatistic#evaluate(...)" do not alter the internal state anymore. | Fix | Methods "evaluate(...)" of class "Variance" changed the internal state although it was stated differently in the javadoc. Fixes [MATH-1205](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1205). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Fixed ignored method parameters in QRDecomposition protected methods. Fixes [MATH-1191](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1191). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Changed javadoc as the RandomDataGenerator class does not implement an interface anymore (the previous interface has been deprecated in 3.X and removed in 4.0). Fixes [MATH-1212](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1212). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Update | Added new API methods in "LeastSquaresProblem.Evaluation" (package "o.a.c.m.fitting.leastsquares"). Fixes [MATH-1206](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1206). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Update | "QRDecomposition": include information about the condition that triggers a "SingularMatrixException". Fixes [MATH-1210](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1210). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Update | Removed broken synchronization support in "ResizableDoubleArray". Fixes [MATH-757](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-757). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Add | Added method "T log10()" to interface "RealFieldElement". Fixes [MATH-945](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-945). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Update | "SpearmansCorrelation" will now throw an "MathIllegalArgumentException" if provided with a "NaturalRanking" instance that uses "REMOVED" as "NaNStrategy". Fixes [MATH-869](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-869). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Update | "NullArgumentException" extends now "java.lang.NullPointerException" instead of "MathIllegalArgumentException". Fixes [MATH-869](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-869). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Update | Renamed "cumulativeProbability(double, double)" to "probability(double, double)" in "IntegerDistribution" and "RealDistribution". Fixes [MATH-839](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-839). Thanks to Gilles Sadowski. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Add | Added logDensity(double) to RealDistribution and logProbability(int) to IntegerDistribution interface. The implementations have already been updated in release 3.3. Fixes [MATH-1039](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1039). Thanks to Aleksei Dievskii. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Update | WELL type pseudo-random number generators have been refactored: the cached indirection index tables per instance are now stored in a static instance. | Remove | Removed "ArithmeticUtils#pow(int, long)" and "ArithmeticUtils#pow(long, long)". Fixes [MATH-1050](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1050). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Update | Method "LaguerreSolver#laguerre(...)" has been made private. Fixes [MATH-825](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-825). Thanks to Gilles Sadowski. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Update | Field "windowSize" in "DescriptiveStatistics" has been made private. Fixes [MATH-760](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-760). Thanks to sebb. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |

### Release 3.6 – 2016-01-05

| Type | Changes | By |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fix | Improved performance and accuracy of 2-sample KolmogorovSmirnov tests. Fixes [MATH-1310](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1310). | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Fix | Detect start failures with multi-step ODE integrators. Fixes [MATH-1297](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1297). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | Added a RotationConvention enumerate to allow specifying the semantics or axis/angle for rotations. This enumerate has two values: VECTOR\_OPERATOR and FRAME\_TRANSFORM. Fixes [MATH-1302,MATH-1303](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1302,MATH-1303). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Fixed stability issues with Adams-Bashforth and Adams-Moulton ODE integrators. The integrators did not estimate the local error properly and were sometimes stuck attempting to reduce indefinitely the step size as they thought the error was too high. Thanks to Julien Queyrel. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | Added a field-based version of Ordinary Differential Equations framework. This allows integrating ode that refer to RealField elements instead of primitive double, hence opening the way to use DerivativeStructure to compute partial differential without using variational equations, or to solve ode with extended precision using Dfp. Fixes [MATH-1288](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1288). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Increased default value for number of allowed evaluations in "o.a.c.m.optim.univariate.BracketFinder". Fixes [MATH-1295](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1295). Thanks to Luke Lindsay. | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Update | Modified 2-sample KolmogorovSmirnovTest to handle ties in sample data. By default, ties are broken by adding random jitter to input data. Also added bootstrap method analogous to ks.boot in R Matching package. Fixes [MATH-1246](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1246). | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Fix | Fixed potential race condition in PolynomialUtils#buildPolynomial in case polynomials are generated from multiple threads. Furthermore, the synchronization is now performed on the coefficient list instead of the class. Fixes [MATH-1294](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1294). Thanks to Kamil Włodarczyk. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Update | Added bootstrap method to KolmogorovSmirnov test. Fixes [MATH-1246](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1246). | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Update | Added constructors taking sample data as arguments to enumerated real and integer distributions. Fixes [MATH-1287](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1287). | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Fix | Fixed FastMath.exp that potentially returned NaN for non-NaN argument. Fixes [MATH-1269](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1269). | [oertl](team-list.html#oertl) |

| Update | Faster generation of Zipf distributed random numbers by using rejection-inversion sampling. Fixes [MATH-1220](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1220). | [oertl](team-list.html#oertl) |

| Fix | "o.a.c.m.stat.regression.OLSMultipleLinearRegression": Use threshold when performing "QRDecomposition". Fixes [MATH-1167](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1167). Thanks to Neil Ireson. | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | "FuzzyKMeansClusterer" has thrown an exception in case one of the data points was equal to a cluster center. Fixes [MATH-1165](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1165). Thanks to Pashutan Modaresi. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Add | Interface to allow parameter validation in "o.a.c.m.fitting.leastsquares": the point computed by by the optimizer can be modified before evaluation. Fixes [MATH-1144](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1144). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Provide access to state derivatives in ContinuousOutputModel. Fixes [MATH-1160](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1160). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Fixed bicubic spline interpolator, using Akima splines. Fixes [MATH-1138](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1138). Thanks to Hank Grabowski. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | Changed classes in the inference package that instantiate distributions to pass null RandomGenerators to avoid initialization overhead for the default generator. Fixes [MATH-1154](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1154). | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Add | Added all Java 8 StrictMath methods to FastMath, so FastMath remains compatible with newer Java versions. Fixes [MATH-1156](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1156). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | Added Gumbel, Laplace, Logistic and Nakagami distributions. Fixes [MATH-1139](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1139). Thanks to Alexey Volkov. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Added statistics missing from toString method in SummaryStatistics. Fixes [MATH-1147](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1147). | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Fix | Improved performance of "EnumeratedDistribution#sample()" by caching the cumulative probabilities and using binary rather than a linear search. Fixes [MATH-1152](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1152). Thanks to Andras Sereny. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | "MonotoneChain" did not take the tolerance factor into account when sorting the input points. In case of collinear points this could result in a "ConvergenceException" when computing the hull. Fixes [MATH-1148](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1148). Thanks to Guillaume Marceau. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Interface "ValueAndJacobianFunction" is a precondition for lazy evaluation (in "o.a.c.m.fitting.leastsquares"). Fixes [MATH-1151](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1151). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Fix potential integer overflows in "MannWhitneyUTest" when providing large sample arrays. Fixes [MATH-1145](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1145). Thanks to Anders Conbere. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Fixed potential null pointer dereferencing in constructor of "DummyStepInterpolator(DummyStepInterpolator)". Fixes [MATH-1149](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1149). Thanks to M Kim. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Fixed BinomialDistribution to deal with degenerate cases correctly. Fixes [MATH-1136](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1136). Thanks to Aleksei Dievskii. | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Fix | "MonotoneChain" failed to generate a convex hull if only a minimal hull shall be created (includeCollinearPoints=false) and collinear hull points were present in the input. Fixes [MATH-1135](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1135). Thanks to Guillaume Marceau. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Improve performance of "KolmogorovSmirnovTest#kolmogorovSmirnovTest(...)" for large samples. Also changed implementation for large n to use Pelz-Good approximation. Fixes [MATH-1131](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1131). Thanks to Schalk W. Cronjé. | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Fix | "BicubicSplineInterpolatingFunction": all fields made final and initialized in the constructor. Added flag to request initialization, or not, of the internal data needed for partial derivatives. Fixes [MATH-1134](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1134). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Constrained EmpiricalDistribution sample/getNextValue methods to return values within the range of the data; correctly linked RandomGenerator to superclass so that RealDistribution reseedRandomGenerator method works. Fixes [MATH-984](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-984). | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Add | Added several different estimation types and NaN handling strategies for Percentile. Fixes [MATH-1120](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1120). Thanks to Venkatesha Murthy. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | Added implementation of PSquare algorithm to estimate percentiles without storing data in memory (i.e. as StorelessUnivariateStatistic). Fixes [MATH-418](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-418). Thanks to Venkatesha Murthy. | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Fix | "Percentile": wrong sorting in the presence of NaN. Fixes [MATH-1129](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1129). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Update | Added lazy evaluation to "LeastSquaresFactory" (in "o.a.c.m.fitting.leastsquares") to avoid evaluating the model when the optimization algorithm does not actually require it. Fixes [MATH-1128](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1128). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Fixed overflow in Precision.equals with ulps (both double and float versions). Fixes [MATH-1127](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1127). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Performance improvements for Student's t-distribution. Fixes [MATH-1125](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1125). Thanks to Ajo Fod. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Fixed NullPointerException when chopping-off a sub-hyperplane that is exactly at a region boundary. Fixes [MATH-1123](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1123). Thanks to Aurélien Labrosse. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | "BrentOptimizer": increment base class iteration counter. Fixes [MATH-1121](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1121). Thanks to Ajo Fod. | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |

### Release 3.3 – 2014-05-05

| Type | Changes | By |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Add | Added new constructor to "OLSMultipleLinearRegression" to be able to specify a custom singularity threshold for QR decomposition. Fixes [MATH-1110](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1110). Thanks to Edward Segall. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Extracted class "LineSearch" from "PowellOptimizer", to be used in "NonLinearConjugateGradientOptimizer" (in place of the implementation that triggered this issue). Fixes [MATH-1092](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1092). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Build properly empty polyhedrons set when given equal min/max boundaries. Also explained better in the javadoc about some wrong usage of PolyhedronsSet constructor. Fixes [MATH-1115](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1115). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Build properly empty polygons set when given equal min/max boundaries. Also explained better in the javadoc about some wrong usage of PolygonsSet constructor. Fixes [MATH-1117](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1117). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | Added a fast single-step method for fixed-step Runge-Kutta integrators. Fixes [MATH-1119](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1119). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | "Complex": Fixed compatibility of "equals(Object)" with "hashCode()". Added new methods for testing floating-point equality between the real (resp. imaginary) parts of two complex numbers. Fixes [MATH-1118](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1118). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Add | Added an order 6 fixed-step ODE integrator designed by H. A. Luther in 1968. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Update | Bracketing utility for univariate root solvers returns a tighter interval than before. It also allows choosing the search interval expansion rate, supporting both linear and asymptotically exponential rates. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Prevent penalties to grow multiplicatively in CMAES for out of bounds points. Fixes [MATH-1107](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1107). Thanks to Bruce A Johnson. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Update | Added KolmogorovSmirnovTest class, deprecating KolmogorovSmirnovDistribution. Fixes [MATH-437](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-437). | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Add | Improved documentation of QR decomposition handling of singular matrices. Fixes [MATH-1101](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1101). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | QR decomposition can compute pseudo-inverses for tall matrices. Fixes [MATH-1053](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1053). Thanks to Sean Owen. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | Field vectors now implement the visitor pattern just like real vectors. Fixes [MATH-820](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-820). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Un-deprecated RealVector.sparseIterator, documenting explicitly that entries not iterated above are the zero ones. Fixes [MATH-875](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-875). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Relaxed specification for function mapping on vectors, thus allowing straightforward implementation for sparse vectors. Fixes [MATH-821](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-821). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Update | Make QR the default in GaussNewtonOptimizer. Fixes [MATH-1099](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1099). Thanks to Evan Ward. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Update | Add Cholesky option to GaussNewtonOptimizer. Fixes [MATH-1099](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1099). Thanks to Evan Ward. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Update | Make QR in GaussNewton faster and more accurate. Fixes [MATH-1099](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1099). Thanks to Evan Ward. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Update | The sparse vector and matrix classes have been un-deprecated. This is a reversal of a former decision, as we now think we should adopt a generally accepted behavior which is ... to ignore the problems of NaNs and infinities in sparse linear algebra entities. Fixes [MATH-870](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-870). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | Added MonotoneChain algorithm to compute the convex hull of a collection of points in 2D. Additionally, the AklToussaintHeuristic can be used to speed up the generation. Fixes [MATH-749](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-749). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Calculating the inverse cumulative probability of an "EnumeratedRealDistribution" will now return the correct result according to the selected enumerated probability mass function. Fixes [MATH-1065](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1065). Thanks to matteodg. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Update | Deprecated "ArithmeticUtils#pow(int, long)" and "ArithmeticUtils#pow(long, long)" in favor of corresponding methods "ArithmeticUtils#pow(..., int)". Fixes [MATH-1050](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1050). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Create additional artifact "commons-math3-x.y.z-tools.jar" as part of the release process. This artifact contains useful tools, e.g. for performance testing. Fixes [MATH-976](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-976). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Improved performance of "MathArrays#sortInPlace(...)". Fixes [MATH-990](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-990). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Clarify javadoc of "DecompositionSolver#getInverse()" and corresponding implementations wrt the actually returned inverse. Several decomposition implementations are able to return a pseudo-inverse in case of a singular matrix. Fixes [MATH-1044](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1044). Thanks to Sean Owen. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Add | Added Emo Welzl algorithm to find the smallest enclosing ball of a collection of points. Fixes [MATH-1095](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1095). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Fixed an indexing problem in "BicubicSplineInterpolatingFunction" which resulted in wrong interpolations. Fixes [MATH-985](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-985). Thanks to Johnathan Kool. | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Add | Added a constructor to "AbstractListChromosome" that does not copy the input argument. Fixes [MATH-1072](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1072). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Add | BSP tree now provides an API to compute a global signed distance from a test point to the region. The distance is positive if the point is outside of the region, negative if the point is inside, and zero when the point is at the boundary. The distance is continuous everywhere, so it can be used with a root solver to identify accurately boundary crossings. This API is available for all BSP trees, in Euclidean and spherical geometries, and in all dimensions. Fixes [MATH-1091](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1091). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | Added new geometry sub-packages: spherical.oned which deals with geometry on the 1-sphere (i.e. the circle) and spherical.twod which deals with the 2-sphere (i.e. the regular sphere). BSP trees can be used in these new spaces, so one can build arcs sets and spherical polygons sets with all the regular operations (inside/outside/boundary checks, union, intersection, symetric difference, complement ...). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | IntervalsSet now implements Iterable<double[]>, so one can iterate over the sub-intervals without building a full list containing a copy of everything beforehand. Fixes [MATH-1090](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1090). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | "Precision#round(double, ...)" will now return negative zero for negative values rounded to zero, similar to the float variant. Fixes [MATH-1089](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1089). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | The iterator returned by "MultiDimensionalCounter#iterator()" will now correctly throw a "NoSuchElementException" when calling "next()" and the iterator is already exhausted. Fixes [MATH-1088](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1088). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Fixed an issue with noisy functions for ODE events detection. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | Utilities for creating artificial neural networks (package "o.a.c.m.ml.neuralnet"). Implementation of Kohonen's Self-Organizing Feature Map (SOFM). Fixes [MATH-923](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-923). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | The cutOff mechanism of the "SimplexSolver" in package o.a.c.math3.optim.linear could lead to invalid solutions. The mechanism has been improved in a way that the tableau does not need to be updated anymore. Additionally, a new check will prevent impossible solutions to be returned as valid. Fixes [MATH-1082](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1082). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Improved performance of "SimplexSolver" in package o.a.c.math3.optim.linear by directly performing row operations and keeping track of the current basic variables. Fixes [MATH-1079](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1079). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Update | The "LinearConstraintSet" will now return the enclosed collection of "LinearConstraint" objects in the same order as they have been added. Fixes [MATH-1080](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1080). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Added support for different pivot selection rules to the "SimplexSolver" by introducing the new "OptimizationData" class "PivotSelectionRule". Currently supported rules are: Dantzig (default) and Bland (avoids cycles). Fixes [MATH-842](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-842). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Fix "Precision#round(float, int, int)" when using rounding mode "BigDecimal.ROUND\_UP" and the discarded fraction is zero. Fixes [MATH-1070](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1070). Thanks to Oleksandr Muliarevych. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Use "FastMath" instead of "Math" within Commons Math. Fixes [MATH-1059](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1059). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Avoid overflow when calculating Kendall's correlation for large arrays. Fixes [MATH-1068](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1068). Thanks to Gal Lalouche. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Avoid infinite recursion in "Beta.regularizedBeta" (package "o.a.c.m.special");. Fixes [MATH-1067](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1067). Thanks to Florian Erhard. | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Add | Refactoring of curve fitters (package "o.a.c.m.fitting"). Fixes [MATH-1014](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1014). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Add | Added possibility to retrieve the best found solution of the "SimplexSolver" in case the iteration limit has been reached. The "optimize(OptimizationData...)" method now supports a "SolutionCallback" which provides access to the best solution if a feasible solution could be found (phase 2 of the Two-Phase simplex method has been reached). Fixes [MATH-970](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-970). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Update | Added new class "ClusterEvaluator" to evaluate the result of a clustering algorithm and refactored existing evaluation code in "MultiKMeansPlusPlusClusterer" into separate class "SumOfClusterVariances". Fixes [MATH-1031](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1031). Thanks to Thorsten Schäfer. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Add | Added InsufficientDataException. Fixes [MATH-1061](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1061). | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Fix | Fixed unintended integer division error in PoissonDistribution sampling method. Fixes [MATH-1056](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1056). Thanks to Sean Owen. | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Fix | Fixed failing unit tests for "BOBYQAOptimizer" when executed with a Oracle/Sun JVM 1.5. Fixes [MATH-1057](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1057). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | A call to "KalmanFilter#correct(...)" may have resulted in "NonSymmetricMatrixException" as the internally used matrix inversion method was using a too strict symmetry check. Fixes [MATH-1062](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1062). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Precision improvements (for small values of the argument) in "Beta" function and in "LogNormalDistribution" and "WeibullDistribution". Fixes [MATH-1058](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1058). Thanks to Sean Owen. | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Fixed some invalid links inside javadoc and added missing deprecated annotations. Fixes [MATH-1055](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1055). Thanks to Sean Owen. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Add | Added a graphical overview of available continuous distributions to the userguide. Fixes [MATH-983](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-983). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Add | Added Kendall's tau correlation (KendallsCorrelation). Fixes [MATH-1051](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1051). Thanks to Matt Adereth,devl. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | "EigenDecomposition" may have failed to compute the decomposition for certain non-symmetric matrices. Port of the respective bugfix in Jama-1.0.3. Fixes [MATH-1051](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1051). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Check for overflow in methods "pow" (class "o.a.c.m.util.ArithmeticUtils"). Fixes [MATH-1047](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1047). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | "EigenDecomposition": Using tolerance for detecting whether a matrix is singular. Fixes [MATH-1045](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1045). Thanks to Sean Owen. | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Add | Added SparseGradient to deal efficiently with first derivatives when the number of variables is very large but most computations depend only on a few of the variables. Fixes [MATH-1036](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1036). Thanks to Ajo Fod. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Update | Added logDensity methods to AbstractReal/IntegerDistribution with naive default implementations and improved implementations for some current distributions. | Add | Added ConfidenceInterval class and BinomialConfidenceInterval providing several estimators for confidence intervals for binomial probabilities. Fixes [MATH-1038](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1038). Thanks to Thorsten Schäfer. | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Fix | Simplified and improved performance of "ArithmeticUtils#addAndCheck(long, long)". Fixes [MATH-1035](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1035). Thanks to derphead. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Add | Added new methods to compute the inverse of a matrix to "DiagonalMatrix" and "MatrixUtils". Fixes [MATH-1004](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1004). Thanks to Ajo Fod. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | The "BigFraction" constructor will throw a "FractionConversionException" also in case negative values are provided which exceed the allowed range (+/- Integer.MAX\_VALUE). Fixes [MATH-1029](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1029). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Add | "Pair": added factory method and "toString" method. Fixes [MATH-1041](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1041). Thanks to Sean Owen. | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Add | "AbstractUnivariateStatistic.test(...)" methods have uses outside subclasses; implementation moved to MathArrays.verifyValues(...). Fixes [MATH-1002](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1002). | [sebb](team-list.html#sebb) |

| Fix | Fix a typo in the test class of "GeometricDistribution" and ensure that a meaningful tolerance value is used when comparing test results with expected values. Fixes [MATH-1037](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1037). Thanks to Aleksei Dievskii. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Add | Added exact binomial test implementation. Fixes [MATH-1034](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1034). Thanks to Thorsten Schäfer. | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Add | Added overloaded constructors for subclasses of "RealDistribution" implementations which do not require an explicit "inverseCumulativeAccuracy". The default accuracy will be used instead. | Add | Added a section to the userguide for the new package o.a.c.m.ml with an overview of available clustering algorithms and a code example. Fixes [MATH-1030](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1030). Thanks to Thorsten Schäfer. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Creating a "Fraction" or "BigFraction" object with a maxDenominator parameter does not throw a "FractionConversionException" anymore in case the value is very close to fraction. | Add | Added new distance metric "EarthMoversDistance". Fixes [MATH-1028](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-1028). Thanks to Thorsten Schäfer. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Improve performance of "DiagonalMatrix#preMultiply(RealVector)". Fixes [MATH-999](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-999). Thanks to Ajo Fod. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |

| Add | Added a NewtonRaphsonSolver that uses the new differentiation package to define the function to solve. This class is intended to replace the former NewtonSolver which is deprecated. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Update | Added RandomDataGenerator to replace RandomDataImpl and deprecated RandomData interface and RandomDataImpl class. Deprecated nextInversionDeviate methods from RandomDataImpl class. Ensured that all nextXxx methods in RandomDataImpl/RandomDataGenerator use the configured RandomGenerator. Fixes [MATH-850](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-850). | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Fix | Generate an exception for rare ill-conditioned cases in "HarmonicFitter" guessing procedure (package "o.a.c.m.optimization.fitting"). Fixes [MATH-844](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-844). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Add | New interface for multivariate distributions. Added multivariate normal distribution. Fixes [MATH-815](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-815). Thanks to Jared Becksfort. | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Add | Added a utility method to compute Stirling numbers of the second kind. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | Added a new package dealing with differentials, for one or more free parameters and derivation order 1 or higher. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | Added additional crossover policies: "CycleCrossover", "NPointCrossover", "OrderedCrossover" and "UniformCrossover". Fixes [MATH-777](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-777). Thanks to Reid Hochstedler. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Improved numerical stability of "SimplexSolver" by introducing Bland's rule to prevent cycling and a cutoff threshold to zero out very small values. Fixes [MATH-828](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-828). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Fixed overflow detection for negative values in constructor of class "Fraction". Fixes [MATH-836](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-836). Thanks to Baste Nesse Buanes. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Fixed overflow in method "percentageValue" in class "Fraction". Fixes [MATH-835](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-835). Thanks to Baste Nesse Buanes. | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Raised (to 10) the default number of fractional digits to print out. Fixes [MATH-622](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-622). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Removed duplicate code. Fixes [MATH-762](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-762). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Add | Added a new "RealMatrixFormat" class for input/output of RealMatrix instances. Default formatter instances for commons-math and octave have been added to "MatrixUtils". Fixes [MATH-831](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-831). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Add | New "IterativeLegendreGaussIntegrator" that performs the same automatic subdivision of the integration interval as "LegendreGaussIntegrator", but uses the classes from package "o.a.c.m.analysis.integration.gauss" to perform the Gauss integration on the sub-interval. Deprecated "LegendreGaussIntegrator". Fixes [MATH-827](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-827). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Improve performance of quantile evaluation in "Percentile" class for cases with lots of equal values. Fixes [MATH-578](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-578). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Add | New framework for Gauss integration schemes (in package "o.a.c.m.analysis.integration.gauss"). Gauss-Legendre quadrature rules (of unlimited order) implemented in double precision, and high precision (using "BigDecimal"). Fixes [MATH-797](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-797). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Add | For all distribution classes (in package "o.a.c.m.distribution"), a new constructor takes a "RandomGenerator" parameter. The "RandomDataImpl" instance has been superseded by this RNG. All "sample()" methods have been modified to use this RNG instead of delegating to the methods in "RandomData". Fixes [MATH-764,MATH-823](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-764,MATH-823). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Add | Added support for real asymmetric matrices to "EigenDecomposition". Fixes [MATH-235](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-235). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Add | Re-instated methods to find all complex roots of a polynomial (class "LaguerreSolver" in package "o.a.c.m.analysis.solvers"). Fixes [MATH-768](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-768). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Add | Added accessors to the "Pair" class (package "o.a.c.m.util"). Fixes [MATH-810](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-810). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Add | Added new constructors in "EigenDecomposition" and deprecated two constructors with unused parameters. Fixes [MATH-822](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-822). Thanks to Jared Becksfort. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Added overridden method in "PolynomialFitter" (package "o.a.c.m.optimization.fitting") to limit the number of evaluations. Fixes [MATH-798](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-798). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Add | Added a new constructor to o.a.c.m.utils.IterationManager, allowing for the specification of a callback function in case the maximum number of iteration is reached. Fixes [MATH-807](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-807). | [celestin](team-list.html#celestin) |
| Add | A new HermiteInterpolator class allows interpolation of vector-valued functions using both values and derivatives of the function at sample points. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Parameterized "CurveFitter" class (package "o.a.c.m.optimization.fitting") with the type of the fitting function. Updated subclasses "PolynomialFitter", "HarmonicFitter", "GaussianFitter". Fixes [MATH-804](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-804). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Fixed a problem when building rotations from two pairs of vectors. In very rare cases, due to numerical inaccuracies the computed quaternion was not normalized (some examples went as high as 1.0e8) and even after normalization, the quaternion was plain wrong. Fixes [MATH-801](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-801). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Remove | Removed unused fields LocalizedFormats.ALPHA and LocalizedFormats.BETA. This is an acceptable compatibility break, as these fields are only meant for internal use. Fixes [MATH-796](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-796). | [celestin](team-list.html#celestin) |
| Fix | Fix computation of upperCumulativeProbability in "HypergeometricDistribution" and cleanup of duplicate probability mass function. Fixes [MATH-644](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-644). Thanks to marzieh. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | In GammaDistribution, deprecated getAlpha() and getBeta(). Replaced with getShape() and getScale(), respectively. Fixes [MATH-791](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-791). | [celestin](team-list.html#celestin) |
| Fix | Use inline computation for OrderedTuple hash code. Fixes [MATH-793](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-793). Thanks to Sebb. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Use modified Lentz-Thompson algorithm for continued fraction evaluation to avoid underflows. Fixes [MATH-718](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-718). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Fixed a wrong assumption on BSP tree attributes when boundary collapses to a too small polygon at a non-leaf node. Fixes [MATH-780](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-780). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Put serialization back for PointValuePair and PointVectorValuePair. Fixes [MATH-787](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-787). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Avoid superfluous null check when using iterators in RealVector and ArrayRealVector. Fixes [MATH-627](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-627). Thanks to Arne Plöse. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Use epsilon instead of ulp in floating-point comparison when dropping columns after phase 1 in SimplexSolver. Fixes [MATH-781](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-781). Thanks to Scheiber Ernő. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Added a workaround for an OpenJDK issue on sparc solaris with too small constants. Fixes [MATH-721](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-721). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Fixed ListPopulation#iterator to return an unmodifiable iterator. Fixes [MATH-779](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-779). Thanks to Reid Hochstedler. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Cleanup of ListPopulation to consistently enforce the population limit. Fixes [MATH-775](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-775). Thanks to Reid Hochstedler. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Use same range check in constructor for ElitisticListPopulation as in corresponding setter. Fixes [MATH-776](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-776). Thanks to Reid Hochstedler. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Fixed unbalanced use of code tags in javadoc of several classes. Fixes [MATH-767](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-767). Thanks to Dennis Hendriks. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Add | Added class FixedElapsedTime (new StoppingCondition for evolution of generations) to genetics package. Fixes [MATH-773](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-773). Thanks to Reid Hochstedler. | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Add | Added classes Decimal64 and Decimal64Field, which are wrapper classes around primitive doubles. These classes implement FieldElement and Field, respectively. Fixes [MATH-756](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-756). | [celestin](team-list.html#celestin) |

| Type | Changes | By |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Add | Added statistical hypothesis tests "MannWhitneyUTest" and "WilcoxonSignedRankTest". Fixes [MATH-431](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-431). | [mikl](team-list.html#mikl) |
| Update | Classes "CMAESOptimizer" and "BOBYQAOptimizer" inherit from "BaseAbstractMultivariateSimpleBoundsOptimizer" (in package "o.a.c.m.optimization.direct"). Fixes [MATH-698](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-698). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |

| Update | Resources for error messages translations have been moved out of META-INF folder in the jar, to avoid interferences with some build systems. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Fixed "doubleValue" and "floatValue" method in "BigFraction" when numerator and denominator are larger than the range of the corresponding primitive type. Fixes [MATH-744](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-744). Thanks to Thundre. | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Update | Removed "MathException" (from package "o.a.c.math"). Fixes [MATH-488](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-488). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Update | Removed "MathRuntimeException" (from package "o.a.c.math"). Fixes [MATH-459](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-459). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Merged interface and implementation of statistical tests in o.a.c.m.stat.inference package. Fixes [MATH-739](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-739). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Update | Merged interface and implementation of EmpiricalDistribution. Fixes [MATH-670](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-670). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |
| Fix | Relaxed test for equality in UnivariateStatisticAbstractTest. Fixes [MATH-588](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-588). | [tn](team-list.html#tn) |

| Fix | Changed algorithm in computation of the covariance matrix in "AbstractLeastSquares" (package "optimization.general"), from "LUDecomposition" to "QRDecomposition". Fixes [MATH-664](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-664). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Fixed rounding error in RandomDataImpl nextInt, nextLong methods causing lower endpoints to be excluded when negative. Also improved robustness of nextUniform for extreme values and changed its contract to throw IAE when provided bounds are infinite or NaN. Fixes [MATH-724](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-724). Thanks to Dennis Hendriks. | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Fix | Fixed "offset by one" bug in "BOBYQAOptimizer". Fixes [MATH-728](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-728). Thanks to Bruce A. Johnson. | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Check first step size in embedded Runge-Kutta integrators, and truncate it if needed. Fixes [MATH-727](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-727). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Modified setSeed methods in Bitstream generators (MersenneTwister and Well generators) to clear the cache of normal deviates used by nextGaussian. Fixes [MATH-723](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-723). | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Fix | Fixed bracketing interval balancing in BracketingNthOrderBrentSolver. Fixes [MATH-716](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-716). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Removed unused or duplicate utility methods from "MathUtils". Math functions with "double" arguments were moved to class "FastMath". Fixes [MATH-690](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-690). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Broke up bloated "MathUtils" class into "MathArrays", "Precision", "ArithmeticUtils" classes. Fixes [MATH-689](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-689). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Fixed array indexing error in Variance evaluate method for computing the weighted variance of an array segment. Fixes [MATH-704](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-704). Thanks to Thomas Neidhart. | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Fix | Fixed case of unconstrained variables that still occur in the objective function in simplex solver. Fixes [MATH-713](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-713). Thanks to Thomas Neidhart. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | The fast cryptographically secure pseudorandom number generator ISAAC has been added. Fixes [MATH-710](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-710). Thanks to Eldar Agalarov. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | The reset method in StepHandler interface has been renamed init and is provided more information on the integration by the calling integrator. A similar init method has been added to the EventHandler interface. Fixes [MATH-714](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-714). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Improved accuracy of Runge-Kutta based step interpolators near step start. Fixes [MATH-705](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-705). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Fixed errors in SummaryStatistics addValue causing variance, mean, or geometric mean statistics not to be updated if they have been overridden using instances of commons-math supplied implementations. Fixes [MATH-691](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-691). | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Update | Removed First, Third, Fourth moments from the public API. These internally used statistics have non-standard definitions. The classes remain, but now have package scope. Fixes [MATH-694](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-694). | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Update | Added support for population variance in StatUtils, SummaryStatistics and DescriptiveStatistics and clarified javadoc to make it clear that 'variance' means sample variance. Fixes [MATH-693](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-693). | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Fix | Fixed BigFraction percentage method which did not work at all. Fixes [MATH-709](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-709). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Update | Added interface and abstract class for supporting optimizers classes that can take simple constraints into account. Fixes [MATH-697](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-697). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Fixed a bad interaction between step handlers and event handlers in ODE integrators. Thanks to MATH-706. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | Added array constructor and getter for Vector2D and Vector3D. Thanks to Jan Kotek. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | Added applyTo and applyInverseTo methods in the Rotation class that handle directly arrays instead of Vector3D instances. Thanks to Jan Kotek. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Added adapters for simple bound constraints optimization that can be used for all direct optimization methods, including the ones that do not support constraints by themselves. Fixes [MATH-196](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-196). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | CMA-ES optimizer input sigma is now consistent with boundaries range units. Fixes [MATH-702](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-702). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |

| Update | Changed the default seed used for RandomDataImpl, AbstractWell and MersenneTwister PRNGs to add the system identity hash code of the instance to the current system time, so generators initialized with default seeds within system clock resolution will generate different sequences. | Fix | Fixed an event resetting issue in ODE. Fixes [MATH-695](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-695). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |

| Add | Method "addToEntry" in "RealVector". Fixes [MATH-685](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-685). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Update | Replaced temporary matrices and entry mutators with double[][] arrays to speed computation in loops within QRDecomposition, Bi- and TriDiagonalTransformer implementations. Fixes [MATH-612](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-612). Thanks to Christopher Nix. | [psteitz](team-list.html#psteitz) |
| Fix | Fixed an integer overflow in OpenMapRealMatrix. Fixes [MATH-679](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-679). Thanks to Christopher Berner. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | "FastMath": Use constant fields instead of recomputing them at method call. Fixes [MATH-688](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-688). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Add | Added Jacobi polynomials. Fixes [MATH-687](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-687). Thanks to Romain di Costanzo. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Add | Added "shift" method to compute the coefficients of a new polynomial whose values are the same as those of another polynomial but computed at a shifted point. Fixes [MATH-683](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-683). Thanks to Romain di Costanzo. | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Faster "multiply" method in "Array2DRowRealMatrix". Code inspired from the Jama project. Fixes [MATH-676](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-676). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
| Fix | Replaced package.html with package-info.java for package documentation. Fixes [MATH-445](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-445). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Added a getRuntimeClass method to the Field interface allowing to use a complete hierarchy of fields sharing a common interface. Fixes [MATH-284](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-284). Thanks to Klaus Hartlage. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | The last remaining uses of OptimizationException have been replaced by unchecked exceptions (UnboundSolutionException, NoFeasibleSolutionException, MaxCountExceededException ...). Fixes [MATH-457](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-457). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | The checked ConvergenceException has been replaced by an unchecked ConvergenceException. Fixes [MATH-487](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-487). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | ODE step interpolation with Jacobians is now fully merged with classical step interpolation. Fixes [MATH-381](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-381). Thanks to Pascal Parraud. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |
| Fix | Completely revamped the computation of Jacobians in ODE. Fixes [MATH-380](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-380). Thanks to Pascal Parraud. | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |

| Update | Added the ability to suppress the estimation of the intercept in SimpleRegression. Fixes [MATH-649](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-649). | [gregs](team-list.html#gregs) |

| Fix | Removed "getData()" method from "RealVector" as it was redundant with "toArray()". Fixes [MATH-663](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-663). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |

| Add | A complete generic implementation of Binary Space Partitioning Trees (BSP trees) has been added. A few specializations of this implementation are also provided for 1D, 2D and 3D Euclidean geometry. This allows support for arbitrary intervals sets (1D), polygons sets (2D) and polyhedrons sets (3D) with all sets operations (union, intersection, symmetric difference, difference, complement), with predicates (point inside/outside/on boundary, emptiness, other region contained), with geometrical computation (barycenter, size, boundary size) and with conversions from and to boundary representation. Fixes [MATH-576](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-576). | [luc](team-list.html#luc) |

| Add | Created an "ExceptionContext" class: It provides the customization feature of "MathRuntimeException" without imposing a singly rooted hierarchy of the Comons Math exceptions. Fixes [MATH-566](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MATH-566). | [erans](team-list.html#erans) |
